# NeuraLogic Business Insights Platform  
AI-driven analytics platform leveraging machine learning for real-time business intelligence. Combines scalable infrastructure, NLP pipelines, and MLOps workflows to transform raw data into actionable insights. Built for enterprises requiring hybrid cloud flexibility and model governance.

## Getting Started / Installation  
```bash  
# Prerequisites  
Python 3.9+  
Docker 20.10+  
kubectl 1.22+  

# Clone repo  
git clone https://github.com/cedricblanc/neuralogic.git  
cd neuralogic  

# Initialize infrastructure  
terraform init  
terraform apply -var region=eu-west-1  

# Launch local dev env  
docker-compose up --build  
```  
Note: This is a hobby project with limited enterprise-grade features. Production use requires additional security and compliance layers.  

## Usage / Examples  
```bash  
# Run inference pipeline  
python inference.py --model-id 12345 --data-path /data/transactions.csv  

# Monitor model drift  
curl http://api:8080/models/12345/metrics  

# Generate NLP insights  
python nlp_analytics.py --corpus-path /data/reviews.txt  
```  
Platform integrates PyTorch/TensorFlow models with LLMs for text analysis, using AWS S3 for storage and GCP BigQuery for analytics.  

## Configuration  
Environment variables in `.env` control cloud provider settings, model registry access, and pipeline thresholds. Terraform variables define cluster size, region, and cost optimization strategies.  

## Deployment  
Deploy via Kubernetes manifests with Terraform-managed EKS/GKE clusters. Auto-scaling rules and cost-optimization policies are baked into the deployment pipeline, reducing cloud spend by 30% in prior projects.  

## Architecture / Design  
Microservices architecture with:  
- Data ingestion layer (Kafka + AWS Kinesis)  
- Model serving (TorchServe + TF Serving)  
- NLP pipeline (HuggingFace Transformers + custom embeddings)  
- Analytics dashboard (React + Grafana)  
Kubernetes orchestrates workloads, while Terraform ensures reproducible infrastructure across AWS and GCP.  

## Tech Stack / Built With  
Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, GCP, Prometheus, Grafana, Apache Kafka, BigQuery, S3, Redis, Elasticsearch.  

## Contributing  
Contributions require experience with MLOps pipelines, hybrid cloud deployments, and NLP model integration. Submit pull requests with benchmarking data and infrastructure-as-code updates. Collaboration is key for cross-cloud optimization.
